summary: Generator TOP for solid color images and simple texture sources. It sets RGBA channels directly, can premultiply RGB by alpha, optionally composites over an input, and can produce 2D, 3D, or 2D texture-array outputs when no input is connected.

key_params.name: color
key_params.note: Color group for red, green, and blue channels.

key_params.name: rgbaunit
key_params.note: UI range for entering color values: 0-1, 0-255, or 0-65535.

key_params.name: compoverinput
key_params.note: Composite the constant image over the input.

key_params.name: operand
key_params.note: Composite operation used when compositing over input.

key_params.name: swaporder
key_params.note: Swap the order of the composite with the input.

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Output texture type when the Constant TOP has no inputs.

key_params.name: slices
key_params.note: Depth of 3D texture or 2D texture array output.

key_concepts: red, green, blue, and alpha channels
common_gotchas: RGBA Units only changes the UI entry range; the TOP data values always use the 0-1 RGBA range internally.
Output Type can only be used when there are no inputs to the Constant TOP.
Multiply RGB by Alpha premultiplies the image, which changes how it behaves in Over/Under composites.
Comp Over Input uses the Output page Operation; without an input, the Constant TOP is just the generated color texture.
Use Info CHOP depth to confirm 3D Texture or 2D Texture Array output slice count.
